title: Lesson 15 - Do You Have This in a Medium?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I'd like to exchange this jacket. I bought a small, but the sleeves are too short.

lines.speaker: Sales associate
lines.text: No problem. Do you have the receipt?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Yes, and I haven't removed the tags. Do you have this in a medium?

lines.speaker: Sales associate
lines.text: We have the same color in a medium. We also have a more fitted cut in medium. Both have longer sleeves.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Could I try both of them on?

lines.speaker: Sales associate
lines.text: Of course. The fitting rooms are behind you.

lines.speaker: Sales associate
lines.text: How does the standard medium fit?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The sleeves are long enough, but the body is too loose. It feels bigger than I need.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: This one fits better. The sleeves are longer than the first jacket's, and the body isn't as loose as the standard medium.

lines.speaker: Sales associate
lines.text: That cut is twelve dollars more expensive.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I saw that. Is the navy one the same price?

lines.speaker: Sales associate
lines.text: Yes, but we only have navy in small and large today.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Then the gray medium is the best option. It's comfortable enough, and the sleeves are the right length. I'll take this one.

lines.speaker: Sales associate
lines.text: Great. I'll process the exchange. You only need to pay the twelve-dollar difference.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Thanks. I'm glad I kept the receipt.
